disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: This panel connects to an anonymous channel on hack.chat, a third-party public anonymous chat service. Before you start, please note:
disclaimer.item1: Channel messages are visible to everyone in the channel; hack.chat servers process message content in plain text (TLS only protects transport).
disclaimer.item2: hack.chat is an independently operated public service; its operators can access chat data on their servers. Do not send sensitive information.
disclaimer.item3: "Anonymous" means no registered identity is required (a random nickname may be used). It is not privacy protection or end-to-end encryption.
disclaimer.item4: Your nickname and preferences are stored only in this plugin's private local storage; chat history is never persisted.
disclaimer.item5: Please follow the hack.chat community rules; you are responsible for what you say.
disclaimer.agree: I have read and understood the above and accept the risks
idle.title: Snow Anonymous Chat
idle.sub: Connect to an anonymous channel on hack.chat and chat anonymously with a random or custom nickname.
input.placeholder: Type a message, Enter to send; /me for action, /nick to rename
sys.reconnectGiveup: Automatic reconnect gave up. Check your network, then reconnect manually.
sys.nickInvalid: Nickname {{nick}} is invalid (1-24 characters; letters, digits, underscores only)
sys.renameSame: New nickname is the same as the current one
sys.renameNotConnected: Connect first to change your nickname
settings.title: Settings
settings.nickHelp: Leave empty to use an auto-generated nickname. That nickname is remembered and reused on reconnect (it no longer changes every time). If filled, it is always used.
settings.savedHint: Settings saved. Connection changes (port, proxy) take effect on the next connect.
rename.title: Change nickname
members.title: Members
idle.bridgeHint: This panel is restricted by the app network policy and needs a local bridge process for external access. The button below starts the bridge automatically (requires terminal permission), then connects.
sys.bridgeStartFail: Bridge start failed: {{error}} (you can run node bridge.mjs manually in a terminal)
settings.nickReset: Auto nickname cleared; a new one is generated on the next connect
settings.bridgePortHelp: Local bridge listening port; leave empty for default 8799; change if conflicting with other software
settings.proxyUrlHelp: Leave empty to auto-detect local proxy (7897/7890/10809 etc.); direct connection if none found; format http://127.0.0.1:7897
settings.portInvalid: Port must be a number between 1024 and 65535
settings.proxyInvalid: Proxy URL must start with http:// or https://
sys.proxyDetected: Local proxy detected: {{proxy}} (saved), will use for connection
sys.proxyNone: No local proxy detected; will connect directly. Configure a proxy in settings if needed
sys.proxyHint: If your network requires a proxy, set it in settings (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7897); leave empty for direct connection
sys.bridgeNodeHint: Bridge did not come up in 15s. Make sure Node.js is installed, or run manually: {{cmd}}
